title: Lean-Formalized Counterexamples to Kaplansky’s Zero-Divisor & Direct-Finiteness Conjectures
aiSystem: OpenAI Internal Frontier Math Model + Lean 4
whyItMatters: Constructs Lean-formalized torsion-free groups refuting Kaplansky’s 86-year-old Zero-Divisor Conjecture and Direct-Finiteness Conjecture over finite fields of positive characteristic.
summary: In its October 6, 2026 release (including Family 196, dated September 23, 2026), OpenAI’s internal frontier math model published explicit, Lean 4-formalized counterexamples to two of Irving Kaplansky’s celebrated conjectures on group rings of torsion-free groups: constructing a torsion-free group whose group algebra over F₂ contains nonzero zero divisors, as well as counterexamples to Kaplansky’s Direct-Finiteness Conjecture in both characteristic two and odd characteristic. Following Giles Gardam’s 2021 human disproof of the Unit Conjecture, these results shatter the remaining positive-characteristic pillars of Kaplansky’s group-ring hierarchy.
technicalHighlights: Explicitly constructs a torsion-free group G and two nonzero elements in F₂[G] whose product vanishes, refuting Kaplansky’s Zero-Divisor Conjecture in characteristic 2.
Provides parallel Lean 4-formalized counterexamples to Kaplansky’s Direct-Finiteness Conjecture in characteristic two and odd characteristic.
Lean theorem statements and proof certificates were indexed in openai/math/lean/formalization.yaml and inspected by external formal-verification trackers (Prove2Me).
caveats: Disproves the positive-characteristic cases; the characteristic-zero versions (e.g., over ℂ or ℚ) remain open, and like all items from OpenAI’s Oct 6 bulk release, independent algebraist peer review of the group-presentation definitions in Lean is still ongoing.

scoreRationale.foundational: Overturns two landmark 1940s conjectures in algebra and geometric group theory that resisted eight decades of human attempts.
scoreRationale.ripple: Directly connects to non-sofic groups, Gottschalk surjunctivity, and operator-algebraic finiteness problems across group rings.
scoreRationale.verification: Explicit algebraic counterexamples accompanied by Lean 4 formalizations, docked pending formal journal refereeing of specification fidelity.
scoreRationale.velocity: Constructed and formalized across multiple positive characteristics within a single automated research sweep.
